007package com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Conversation;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Team;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
012
013import java.util.Map;
014
015/**
016 * Input and optional runtime parameters for {@link Team#run(RunTeamRequest)}
017 * and {@link SelectAIAgent#runTeam(String, RunTeamRequest)}.
018 *
019 * <p>For a run without established database session context, supply a
020 * conversation identifier returned by {@link Conversation#create()} or
021 * {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI.CREATE_CONVERSATION}; an arbitrary client-generated ID
022 * is not sufficient. Reuse the same identifier for an initial run and a later
023 * call that resumes a team waiting for human input, including across pooled
024 * database connections. The caller must retain the identifier between calls.
025 * Use {@link RunTeamParams} to provide the complete typed runtime-parameter
026 * object. The convenience builder methods on this class are equivalent.
027 * Runtime maps are copied when set and are not included in diagnostic output
028 * by this class.</p>
029 *
030 * <p>For a runnable example, see
031 * <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/RunTeamSample.html">
032 * RunTeamSample source</a>.</p>
033 *
034 * @since 1.1.0
035 */
036public final class RunTeamRequest {
037    /** Optional user prompt or response to a request for human input. */
038    private final String userPrompt;
039    /** Typed runtime parameters, or null when none were supplied. */
040    private final RunTeamParams params;
041
042    private RunTeamRequest(Builder builder, RunTeamParams params) {
043        this.userPrompt = builder.userPrompt;
044        this.params = params;
045    }
046
047    /**
048     * Returns the optional prompt or response supplied to the team.
049     *
050     * @return user prompt or human response, or {@code null} when unset
051     */
052    public String getUserPrompt() {
053        return userPrompt;
054    }
055
056    /**
057     * Returns the optional conversation identifier.
058     *
059     * @return conversation identifier, or {@code null} when unset
060     */
061    public String getConversationId() {
062        return params == null ? null : params.getConversationId();
063    }
064
065    /**
066     * Returns immutable instruction variables, or {@code null} when unset.
067     *
068     * @return immutable instruction variables, or {@code null}
069     */
070    public Map<String, Object> getInstructionVariables() {
071        return params == null ? null : params.getInstructionVariables();
072    }
073
074    /**
075     * Returns immutable attribute variables, or {@code null} when unset.
076     *
077     * @return immutable attribute variables, or {@code null}
078     */
079    public Map<String, Object> getAttributeVariables() {
080        return params == null ? null : params.getAttributeVariables();
081    }
082
083    /**
084     * Returns immutable state variables, or {@code null} when unset.
085     *
086     * @return immutable state variables, or {@code null}
087     */
088    public Map<String, Object> getStateVariables() {
089        return params == null ? null : params.getStateVariables();
090    }
091
092    /**
093     * Returns the typed runtime parameters, or {@code null} when unset.
094     *
095     * @return immutable runtime parameters, or {@code null}
096     */
097    public RunTeamParams getParams() {
098        return params;
099    }
100
101    /**
102     * Returns the database params JSON, or {@code null} when no runtime
103     * parameters were set.
104     *
105     * @return serialized runtime parameters, or {@code null}
106     */
107    public String toParamsJson() {
108        return params == null ? null : params.toParamsJson();
109    }
110
111    /**
112     * Creates a builder for a team run.
113     *
114     * @return mutable builder for a team-run request
115     */
116    public static Builder builder() {
117        return new Builder();
118    }
119
120    /** Builder for {@link RunTeamRequest}. */
121    public static final class Builder {
122        /** Optional user prompt or response to a request for human input. */
123        private String userPrompt;
124        /** Typed runtime parameters. */
125        private RunTeamParams params;
126        /** Optional identifier used by the convenience builder methods. */
127        private String conversationId;
128        /** Optional instruction variables used by the convenience builder methods. */
129        private Map<String, Object> instructionVariables;
130        /** Optional attribute variables used by the convenience builder methods. */
131        private Map<String, Object> attributeVariables;
132        /** Optional state variables used by the convenience builder methods. */
133        private Map<String, Object> stateVariables;
134
135        private Builder() {
136        }
137
138        /**
139         * Sets the optional team prompt or human response.
140         *
141         * @param userPrompt user query or response to a human-input request
142         * @return this builder
143         */
144        public Builder userPrompt(String userPrompt) {
145            this.userPrompt = userPrompt;
146            return this;
147        }
148
149        /**
150         * Sets typed runtime parameters for the team run.
151         *
152         * @param params immutable runtime parameters
153         * @return this builder
154         */
155        public Builder params(RunTeamParams params) {
156            this.params = params;
157            return this;
158        }
159
160        /**
161         * Sets an application-managed conversation identifier for cross-session
162         * runs.
163         *
164         * @param conversationId database-created conversation identifier
165         * @return this builder
166         */
167        public Builder conversationId(String conversationId) {
168            this.conversationId = conversationId;
169            return this;
170        }
171
172        /**
173         * Sets instruction variables as a snapshot of a JSON-compatible map.
174         *
175         * @param instructionVariables values substituted into task instructions
176         * @return this builder
177         */
178        public Builder instructionVariables(Map<String, ?> instructionVariables) {
179            this.instructionVariables = snapshot(instructionVariables);
180            return this;
181        }
182
183        /**
184         * Sets attribute variables as a snapshot of a JSON-compatible map.
185         *
186         * @param attributeVariables values that override configurable attributes
187         * @return this builder
188         */
189        public Builder attributeVariables(Map<String, ?> attributeVariables) {
190            this.attributeVariables = snapshot(attributeVariables);
191            return this;
192        }
193
194        /**
195         * Sets state variables as a snapshot of a JSON-compatible map.
196         *
197         * @param stateVariables values shared between tools during a run
198         * @return this builder
199         */
200        public Builder stateVariables(Map<String, ?> stateVariables) {
201            this.stateVariables = snapshot(stateVariables);
202            return this;
203        }
204
205        /**
206         * Builds an immutable request; a prompt and runtime parameters are
207         * optional. Building does not modify this builder; it may be reused
208         * to create further requests without changing previously built ones.
209         *
210         * <p>For a runnable example, see
211         * <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/RunTeamParamsSample.html">
212         * RunTeamParamsSample source</a>.</p>
213         *
214         * @return immutable team-run request
215         * @throws IllegalArgumentException when typed and convenience runtime
216         *                                  parameters are mixed
217         */
218        public RunTeamRequest build() {
219            if (params != null && (conversationId != null
220                    || instructionVariables != null || attributeVariables != null
221                    || stateVariables != null)) {
222                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
223                        "params cannot be combined with individual runtime parameter fields");
224            }
225            RunTeamParams resolvedParams = params;
226            if (resolvedParams == null && (conversationId != null
227                    || instructionVariables != null || attributeVariables != null
228                    || stateVariables != null)) {
229                RunTeamParams.Builder paramsBuilder = RunTeamParams.builder();
230                if (conversationId != null) {
231                    paramsBuilder.conversationId(conversationId);
232                }
233                if (instructionVariables != null) {
234                    paramsBuilder.instructionVariables(instructionVariables);
235                }
236                if (attributeVariables != null) {
237                    paramsBuilder.attributeVariables(attributeVariables);
238                }
239                if (stateVariables != null) {
240                    paramsBuilder.stateVariables(stateVariables);
241                }
242                resolvedParams = paramsBuilder.build();
243            }
244            return new RunTeamRequest(this, resolvedParams);
245        }
246
247        private static Map<String, Object> snapshot(Map<String, ?> values) {
248            if (values == null) {
249                return null;
250            }
251            return RunTeamParams.builder().instructionVariables(values).build()
252                    .getInstructionVariables();
253        }
254    }
255}
